scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/probability-engine && npm run prisma:generate -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/probability-engine && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/probability-engine && npm run test -w apps/api
